# Brief: Xfinity Mobile Cross-Sell to Internet Customers

**From:** Tanya Brooks, Mobile Acquisition
**Workfront:** Q4 Mobile Growth

## What we're doing
We want to get Internet-only customers to add Xfinity Mobile with the "first line free for a year" offer. Goal is new mobile lines, obviously, but we'd also like to see if it moves Internet retention.

## Who
- Current residential Internet customers
- No Xfinity Mobile lines on the account
- Been with us at least 6 months
- Good standing on their bill

## Who not
- Anyone who had Mobile in the past and cancelled in the last year
- People in the Q4 speed upgrade campaign (don't want to double up)

## Channels
Email through Campaign, 2 sends. We'd also like an in-app banner in the Xfinity app if that's possible for this audience.

## Timing
Want the first email out the week of October 20. Runs through end of November.
